Name: Pinned, bottom bleed
Positioning & Geometry Rules: Inset 8-12% left, right, top; 15-35% past bottom; centered
Satellite & Neighbor Contract: Optional satellite straddling a side edge

Name: Corner bleed
Positioning & Geometry Rules: Inset 10% top & left; 15-35% past right & bottom
Satellite & Neighbor Contract: Satellite straddling left or bottom perimeter

Name: Stage with gutters
Positioning & Geometry Rules: Inset 8-20% sides on colored ground; bleeds off bottom
Satellite & Neighbor Contract: Satellite straddling one side; hero stays centered

Name: Satellite focus
Positioning & Geometry Rules: Hero cropped aggressively as contextual background
Satellite & Neighbor Contract: Dominant satellite (30-40% hero width) carrying core story

Name: Wide hero
Positioning & Geometry Rules: 900-1100px window at 1:1, inset top, bleeding off bottom & sides
Satellite & Neighbor Contract: Card or thread along lower boundary

Name: Row of windows
Positioning & Geometry Rules: 3-4 windows at identical height, outer ones bleeding off sides
Satellite & Neighbor Contract: None; uniform rhythm across parallel panes
Ideal Scenario: Multi-agent swarms, parallel sessions, browser tabs

Name: Device pair
Positioning & Geometry Rules: Desktop window inset top/left (75-80% width), off bottom; device pair desktop phone straddling right edge
Satellite & Neighbor Contract: Phone straddling right edge (33% outside), top in upper half

Name: Many of one
Positioning & Geometry Rules: Uniform grid of repeated small cards bleeding off all 4 edges
Satellite & Neighbor Contract: None; exactly one card elevated by hero shadow & accent ring

Name: Fade crop
Positioning & Geometry Rules: Window inset top & sides; bottom 30% dissolves via CSS gradient mask
Satellite & Neighbor Contract: Optional peripheral satellite
Ideal Scenario: Cases where a hard edge slice looks unnatural

Name: Close-up
Positioning & Geometry Rules: Window scaled 1.3-1.6x, inset top & sides, bleeding off bottom
Satellite & Neighbor Contract: None; 1:1 control legibility focus
Ideal Scenario: Detailed control studies (single input or button)

Name: Panel over product
Positioning & Geometry Rules: Product inset top/left, bleeding off bottom
Satellite & Neighbor Contract: Settings panel straddling right margin with leader connector line
Ideal Scenario: Settings driving live changes (theming, config toggles)

Name: Overlapping windows
Positioning & Geometry Rules: Back window inset top, bleeding off bottom
Satellite & Neighbor Contract: Smaller front card aligned to structural column (sidebar edge)
Ideal Scenario: Multi-perspective flows (buyer card over merchant dashboard)

Name: Stacked cards
Positioning & Geometry Rules: Two cards of identical width & left alignment, 12px apart
Satellite & Neighbor Contract: None; lower card bleeds off bottom
Ideal Scenario: Parent-child hierarchies (subscription plan over usage meter)

Name: Opposite corners
Positioning & Geometry Rules: Copy pinned bottom-left; product hung off top-right corner
Satellite & Neighbor Contract: None; diagonal balance across stage
Ideal Scenario: Bento cards with prominent typographic headlines

Name: Tilted stack
Positioning & Geometry Rules: 3 identical cards (-6deg, +4deg, -2deg tilt, 12-20px offset)
Satellite & Neighbor Contract: None; top card is straight and holds the only text
Ideal Scenario: Physical paper items (receipts, boarding passes, invoices)

Name: Corner chip
Positioning & Geometry Rules: Window inset top-left, bleeding off bottom
Satellite & Neighbor Contract: Small pill centered on window corner (50% outside)
Ideal Scenario: Global system indicators (active users, connection health)

Name: Monochrome row
Positioning & Geometry Rules: 3 grayscale windows at equal height with bottom fade mask
Satellite & Neighbor Contract: None; restrained multi-surface harmony
Ideal Scenario: Multi-brand partner integrations avoiding color clash

Name: Not Every Tile is UI
Positioning & Geometry Rules: UI appears on 1/3 to 1/2 of tiles maximum
Satellite & Neighbor Contract: Remaining tiles must be stats, statements, objects, diagrams, or collections

Name: One Hero Tile
Positioning & Geometry Rules: Exactly one tile dominates (spanning 2 columns or 2 rows)
Satellite & Neighbor Contract: Peripheral tiles defer optically to the hero narrative
Ideal Scenario: Anchor visual hierarchy across 5-6 feature bento grids

Name: UI Tiles Crop to Components
Positioning & Geometry Rules: Crop tightly to a single control (stepper, toggle, picker, row) at 1:1 or 1.25x
Satellite & Neighbor Contract: Window chrome appears at most once per grid (on hero only)

Name: Checkerboard Neighbor Contrast
Positioning & Geometry Rules: Alternate density, archetype kind, and silhouette horizontally and vertically
Satellite & Neighbor Contract: Two window crops or two stat tiles must never touch

Name: Big Type is a Tile
Positioning & Geometry Rules: Display stat tiles use 48-72px numerals, short lead, single-line label, <=1 glyph
Satellite & Neighbor Contract: Ban arbitrary 10x marketing slop placeholders

Name: Copy is Short and External
Positioning & Geometry Rules: 1-4 word title or single sentence + <=1 supporting line at 17-24px
Satellite & Neighbor Contract: Never shrink tile copy to internal UI micro-sizes

Name: Uniform Outer Frame, Varied Interior
Positioning & Geometry Rules: Share outer border-radius, grid gap, padding, and copy slot (all top or all bottom)
Satellite & Neighbor Contract: Internal grounds, textures, and materials vary per tile

Name: Deliberate Bleed and Containment
Positioning & Geometry Rules: Outer tile boundary owns the crop; inner stages match container width
Satellite & Neighbor Contract: Zero nested-composition-crop accidental inner margins
Ideal Scenario: Bento tiles hosting embedded StageShow scenes

Name: Single-Occurrence Identity
Positioning & Geometry Rules: Strings, avatars, brand marks, and chrome elements appear at most once
Satellite & Neighbor Contract: Never repeat duplicate demo personas or logos across neighbor tiles

Name: Composed Ground Rhythm
Positioning & Geometry Rules: Balance lightness, color temperature, and saturation across tile grounds
Satellite & Neighbor Contract: Avoid clashing saturated neighbors

Name: Single Motion Leader
Positioning & Geometry Rules: Supporting grids use micro scroll-triggered motion (80-120ms stagger)
Satellite & Neighbor Contract: At most one narrative cursor flow while neighbor tiles stay calm

Name: 1:1 Native Resolution (One Stage Per Tile)
Positioning & Geometry Rules: Each tile picture mounts its own independent 1:1 Stage
Satellite & Neighbor Contract: Never wrap an entire bento grid inside one scaling Stage
Ideal Scenario: Preserve crisp typography across responsive viewports

Name: Fluid Responsive Recomposition
Positioning & Geometry Rules: Reflow columns by content constraints (2 cols ~550px, 1 col mobile); >=10px floor
Satellite & Neighbor Contract: Never scale-shrink multi-column grids onto mobile

Name: Single-Line Stat Numbers
Positioning & Geometry Rules: Keep numeral and unit together on one line (white-space: nowrap)
Satellite & Neighbor Contract: Move long units into the supporting lead label rather than wrapping

Name: Usage into Invoice (collect)
Positioning & Geometry Rules: 3 measured usage input rows route through white-rimmed junction node
Satellite & Neighbor Contract: Incoming routes draw once; output delivery starts after inputs land

Name: Payout & Detail (detail)
Positioning & Geometry Rules: Row selection opens settlement detail card; dotted record link + solid leader
Satellite & Neighbor Contract: Leader stops 4-6px short of target edge with 4px dot, never bisecting corners

Name: Chart Point (chart)
Positioning & Geometry Rules: Selected point measured via rect() feeds straight/step Connector to callout
Satellite & Neighbor Contract: Outside click dismisses callout cleanly without covering active series

Name: Selection & Dimensions (measure)
Positioning & Geometry Rules: Shared bounding box wraps resizable card, selection ring, and live readout
Satellite & Neighbor Contract: Guides update synchronously with resize handle geometry
Ideal Scenario: Canvas, CAD, and layout inspector tools

Name: Request & Reply (flow)
Positioning & Geometry Rules: Solid outbound leader draws from sender; dashed return arrow starts at recipient
Satellite & Neighbor Contract: Route completion precedes inline HTTP/status badge reveal
Ideal Scenario: API webhook, RPC, and protocol sequence diagrams

Name: Following a Layer (follow)
Positioning & Geometry Rules: Single <Follow> coordinate container wraps both moving object and note
Satellite & Neighbor Contract: Annotation travels synchronously without per-frame rect() lag
Ideal Scenario: Draggable cards and spatial multiplayer cursors

Name: Shared Processing Graph (branch)
Positioning & Geometry Rules: Single measured trunk fans out along shared spine with per-branch junction nodes
Satellite & Neighbor Contract: Pill worker nodes center dynamically without empty pre-check icon gaps
Ideal Scenario: DAG fan-out, CI/CD, and multi-agent swarm orchestration

Name: Ongoing Event Stream (stream)
Positioning & Geometry Rules: Static measured route carries animated stroke-dashoffset phase dots
Satellite & Neighbor Contract: Pauses offscreen via IntersectionObserver; collapses to static poster on reduced-motion
Ideal Scenario: Live telemetry and event ingestion streams
